newsitem.title: USA: NABI Inc adopts shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: NABI Inc adopts shareholder rights plan.

text.p: NABI Inc said Monday that it has adopted a Preferred Stock Purchase Rights Plan designed to ensure that all NABI stockholders receive fair and equal treatment in the event of a proposed takeover of the company and to deter abusive takeover tactics.
The company added that it is currently unaware of plans by anyone to purchase all or part of the company.
NABI said that the plan, which expires August 1, 2007, would be exercisable only if a person or group acquired 15 percent or more of NABI's common stock or attempted to do so.
NABI is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of products that prevent and treat autoimmune and infectious diseases.
